ticket.title: Backlog Kanban, List view, and comprehensive Task Inspector surfacing rich task data
ticket.description: Implement CAD-styled backlog panel with view switcher (DAG, Kanban, List), dense sortable issue table, and comprehensive task inspector/drawer surfacing all rich data (status/kind/priority badges, scope coordinates, target files/symbols, labels, acceptance criteria, decisions & inherited decisions, dependency edges, verification receipt, complete agent handoff packet, collision warnings, and deferred issues) with synthesis triggers on ready cards.
acceptance_criteria: Surfacing comprehensive status, kind, and priority badges in task inspector header
Surfacing full scope coordinates: repo, crate, module path, target files, target symbols, and labels
Displaying acceptance criteria checklist with completion states
Surfacing task decisions and inherited decisions (status, question, proposed options, chosen option, rationale, resolver)
Surfacing graph edges and dependencies (blocked by, related to, parent epic, related tasks summary)
Displaying full verification gate details (verification command and verification receipt with verifier, exit code, diagnostic count, and summary)
Displaying complete agent handoff packet (recording agent, completed items, remaining items, blockers, git ref, and dirty files)
Displaying file collision warnings and known deferred issues in scope
Actionable synthesis trigger directly accessible on ready task cards and inspector

task.title: Add Kanban board, tabular issue list, and task inspector to backlog panel
task.description: Add top-bar view switcher in Panel 2 (DAG, Kanban, List), implement status-column Kanban board, dense sortable issue table, rich task detail inspector, and relocate synthesis run triggers directly onto Ready task cards.
